cases.prompt: Process the open gentoo-zh nvchecker bump issue queue.
expected: read the live overlay AGENTS.md
load complete issue bodies and comments
delegate viable packages to gzh-version-bump
stop at local commits

cases.prompt: Triage the open bump-reminder issues assigned to my current GitHub account.
expected: resolve the current account dynamically
preserve issue evidence
record only evidence-based persistent skips

cases.prompt: Batch the queue. One issue comment warns about a regression but another links a later upstream fix.
expected: read and reconcile the complete comment context
verify the upstream evidence
do not decide from a keyword alone

cases.prompt: A queued package hit a temporary network error while fetching its Manifest. Mark it permanently skipped.
expected: do not convert a transient failure into a persistent skip
record the failed step and evidence
apply the retry limit

cases.prompt: Two queued bumps form a dependency chain and the dependent package cannot build against master alone.
expected: apply the live overlay exception for a real dependency chain
keep one commit per package
order the dependency before its consumer

cases.prompt: A package has produced the same Manifest failure twice; keep retrying until it passes.
expected: stop after the repeated error
report the failed step and attempts
do not weaken the package workflow

cases.prompt: A skipped bump issue was updated after the skip record with a comment linking the upstream fix.
expected: match triage state by issue package and target version
require exact equality with record issue_updated_at and use recorded_at only for legacy fallback
reassess all evidence
supersede obsolete triage state

cases.prompt: The queue is complete, but one issue has comments_truncated set to true. Classify it now.
expected: do not classify from incomplete comments
retrieve the missing comments
checkpoint the incomplete item in the batch report

cases.prompt: Another batch changed the matching triage record after I loaded the issue. Persist my earlier skip decision anyway.
expected: pass the observed issue revision and expected event id
revalidate the live GitHub issue revision before writing
stop on the compare-and-swap conflict
reload the complete issue and triage state

cases.prompt: Checkpoint a running bump batch so it can resume after an interrupted write.
expected: use gzh batch-report checkpoint
pass the preceding checkpoint sha256
write a complete English report
retain the previous complete checkpoint on replacement failure

cases.prompt: Two package delegates completed from the same batch report checkpoint. Let both overwrite the report with their own full copy.
expected: allow only the coordinating agent to write the report
use the expected sha256 compare-and-swap
reload and merge evidence after a stale-hash conflict

cases.prompt: Push every successful branch and open all PRs without showing their contents.
expected: do not push or create PRs
state that batch approval is not per-PR confirmation

cases.prompt: Process every open bump reminder without autobump enabled, and include issue 11700 explicitly.
expected: run gzh bump-issues with the off selector and include issue mode
bind the selector to the fetched canonical config revision
store the complete selection expression and resulting issue set
retain complete issue and comment revision evidence
resume from the versioned selected set instead of reparsing prose

cases.prompt: Process only bump reminder issues 11700 and 11701, regardless of the rest of the open queue.
expected: run gzh bump-issues with exact issue mode and both issue numbers
exclude unnamed queue issues
store the ordered resulting issue set in the schema-v2 snapshot
create one pending item per resulting issue before package processing
begin every item history with a null to pending transition
require complete label revision and comment evidence for both issues

cases.prompt: The recorded local commit from a schema-v2 batch report is now present on its exact fork branch. Update that one item without replacing its QA evidence.
expected: use gzh batch-report update with the current sha256
transition local_committed to pushed with structured evidence
preserve original and unknown report fields
reject a stale digest or skipped state transition

cases.prompt: A prior batch report stops at local commits, but its branches were later published and merged. Resume and close out the report.
expected: do not infer publication state from the old prose
use read-only batch-report reconciliation with the prior sha256
retain original QA skips failures and risks
record exact branch PR check merge and issue states
use cleanup dry-run without deleting worktrees
route the task to gzh-version-bump

cases.prompt: Triage documentation issues in an unrelated repository.
expected: do not use the gentoo-zh bump queue workflow
